projectionDefinitions.low: Repeat cheapest completed observation; optimistic sensitivity, not guaranteed lower bound.
projectionDefinitions.central: Unweighted mean of four completed V7/V8 observations, multiplied by 46; very small mixed-cap sample.
projectionDefinitions.high: Repeat V8 ordinal4 completed observation; not a guaranteed upper bound.
projectionDefinitions.fullCap: All 46 output ceilings exhausted, all input at largest observed input count and highest frozen input rate.
projectionDefinitions.guard: Four times largest observed input count (76428), highest input rate, full 25000 output: $0.220535 per attempt, rounded upward to $0.225. Every fixed frozen payload fits byte length plus 4096 within that input allowance.

limitations: No account balance inspected or inferred.
Token forecasts extrapolate only the stated observed V7/V8 cases; no V5 historical usage or new provider estimates used.
Byte-envelope/input allowance is a deliberately conservative engineering estimate, not a provider-tokenization or billing guarantee.
A smaller future approved ceiling will stop before all 46 calls if the next fixed reservation does not fit.

The temporary $0.225 reservation is replaced with verified estimated cost only after immutable uploaded result and usage verification. Missing, invalid or uncertain evidence retains the reservation and stops. $10.35 is conservative maximum capacity, not mandatory minimum approval.
